annotations.title: skypeek: satellite image of a place (Sentinel-2 true color, NDVI, NDWI)

description: skypeek: Get a recent satellite image of a place or coordinates. For the forecast use get_weather. Returns a recent satellite picture of a place as a base64 PNG, with the capture date, cloud cover, source and attribution: the least cloudy recent Sentinel-2 L2A scene at 10 m per pixel as true colour, NDVI (vegetation) or NDWI (water), clouds painted grey in the index views; NASA GIBS true colour (about 250 m) for areas wider than 10 km or when Sentinel-2 has no scene. Not real time (`date` is the scene day); clouds can hide the ground (404 too_cloudy, no_scene, no_imagery: not charged). Sentinel-2 data is free to use with credit; NASA GIBS has no restrictions. Not for navigation or safety. Typically 5 to 25 s (a few Sentinel-2 tiles are read and rendered). Price: USD 0.01. Free: 5 skypeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/satellite-image-api.html

date.description: Target day YYYY-MM-DD (2015-07 onward, not in the future): the nearest scene within 15 days that is clear enough. Default: the newest clear scene of the last 60 days.
date.title: Date

lat.description: Latitude in degrees (-90 to 90). Send lat and lon, or place.
lat.title: Lat

lon.description: Longitude in degrees (-180 to 180). Send lat and lon, or place.
lon.title: Lon

max_cloud.description: Most cloud accepted, as a percent of the pictured area (0-100, default 30). No scene that clear is a 404 too_cloudy (not charged).
max_cloud.title: Max Cloud

place.description: City name, optionally with a country code (such as Manila, PH); cities of 15,000+ people. Send place, or lat and lon.
place.title: Place

radius_m.description: Half the side of the pictured square, in metres (250-100000, default 2560: about 10 m per pixel at 512 px). Over 10000 is NASA 250 m true colour only.
radius_m.title: Radius M

size.description: Width and height of the PNG in pixels (128-1024, default 512).
size.title: Size

view.description: true_color (a natural-colour picture), ndvi (vegetation) or ndwi (open water), both computed from the same Sentinel-2 scene with clouds painted grey.
view.title: View

name: get_satellite_image

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
